description: Statements this pack must resolve to, none of them written as selection terms. The first eight are Mathlib theorem statements, phrased by Mathlib's authors before this pack existed; the rest are ordinary textbook phrasings. The pack's own declared examples measure whether the signal list matches the examples the signal list was written from, which is not a measurement. Extended after the journey test found the pack unable to resolve a statement of pure logic: the original cases were library statements prefixed 'Prove that', which carries a strong signal on its own and made the set easier than the prose it stands in for.
